key_sections.title: 1. Type Ia vs Core-Collapse Supernovae
key_sections.content:
Type Ia supernovae occur in binary white dwarf systems exceeding the Chandrasekhar limit. Core-collapse supernovae occur when massive stars (>8 solar masses) exhaust nuclear fuel and collapse. Understanding this phenomenon requires analyzing the underlying thermodynamic, gravitational, and electromagnetic forces at play.
